authorization_record: User approved the proposed read-only visual feature scale, activation saturation and fusion-path inspection. This records scope, not a digital signature or training authorization.

protocol.question: Locate descriptive scale/saturation/fusion evidence that might explain weak local visual response, without changing inputs or architecture or claiming a causal repair.
protocol.source: Same pinned native LIBERO Spatial9/source39 task, existing8-train/4-validation split and unchanged clean feature cache. Raw scales use all1134 unique train and524 unique validation rows separately. No source acquisition, camera processing or new embeddings.
protocol.baselines: All3 seeds x2 action arms at the original step0 initialization and final200 checkpoint. Private CPU initialization must reproduce original parameter bytes and predictions exactly; trusted final checkpoint binding keeps old training authorization. No seed/checkpoint/model selection.
protocol.model_inputs: Only same500 original clean validation windows, history4/horizon3, state8/action7/task and alltrue masks. Original train normalization unchanged. Zero-action arm is zero in normalized coordinates, raw train mean, not physical hold. No visual perturbation, blackout or new action ablation.
protocol.capture: Read-only forward hooks capture actual outputs and downstream input arguments: view projection pre/post, history concatenation/pre/post, context GRU hidden, task embedding, context-task concatenation/pre and actual initial post, action projection pre/post, future hidden and both actual residual heads. One actual native forward, no replacement output. Actual tanh posts must byte-match their preactivations through the same explicit operation; full output must replay the saved reference hash. Hooks, input bytes, parameter identities/versions/content remain unchanged.
protocol.saturation: For the five explicit tanh pairs only, lock thresholds |post|>=0.99, >=0.999 and exactly1; report counts/fractions. Local float32-output slope proxy is1-post_float64_squared, report mean/min/max and <=0.01/0.001 counts/fractions. This is not backward gradients, a Jacobian, GRU internal-gate saturation, or causal feature importance.
protocol.scale_metrics: Per tensor count/sum/squared_sum/absolute_sum/min/max/mean/mean_abs/RMS/centered variance. Coordinate-center RMS and within-coordinate standard-deviation RMS distinguish large constant offsets from variation. Raw scales use unique rows; model activations use overlapping validation history windows, not independent frames. No scale statistic is fed back as an input transform.
protocol.fusion: Small descriptive float64 affine decomposition of history_projection into view0/view1/visual_mask/state/state_mask/bias, and context_task_projection into context/task/bias. Groups exactly cover all input columns and have identical output dimensions. Compare sum(parts) to float64 full affine with a numerical guard; report difference to actual float32 preactivation separately. No percentage attribution: norms can cancel, and constant task/mask terms do not carry sample discrimination.
protocol.aggregation: Batch sufficient summaries and activation hashes; per-episode, window-weighted micro and equal-episode macro, then3-seed means/descriptive population std and paired final-minus-step0. No significance from these optimizer seeds. Coordinate moments are streaming helper statistics, not reconstructed from pooled scalar means alone.
protocol.efficiency: 396 clean CPU float32 native model forwards total (12 groups x33 batches). No loss evaluation, backward, optimizer, persistence prediction, new encoding or policy rollout. Read-only float64 affine and moment arithmetic are diagnostics, not extra model forwards.
protocol.recovery: Exclusive output with preflight/start/failure or completed status. No overwrite, automatic retry, checkpoint update, resume or outcome-dependent threshold change. Inspect PID/status after disconnect before further action.
protocol.decision: Report where saturation or weak variation is observed, separately at initialization/final and each seed/arm. Do not state it is the sole cause, promise gains from normalization/another architecture, or implement/train a repair automatically.

limitations: Only one task and4 already-inspected validation episodes;3 seeds are optimizer initializations, not independent trajectories. Unknown PI0.5 pretraining overlap and unverified family independence remain.
All state/action/task inputs are available. This clean activation inspection does not establish the causal usefulness of a modality or identify data/target shortcuts by itself.
Saturation/local slope metrics apply only to explicit tanh operations, not internal GRU gates or backpropagated gradients. No gradient or Jacobian is measured.
Large affine component magnitudes are not causal shares; cancellation and float32/float64 rounding are possible. Task embedding and validity masks are constant in this one-task allvalid setting.
Unique-row raw scales and overlapping-window activation scales have different sampling weights. Per-coordinate variance across positions is not purely temporal variance or independent evidence count.
No input normalization is changed or fitted for use, no architecture/loss repair is implemented or trained. Any repair requires a separately specified matched-budget comparison.
No robustness certification, policy success, guidewire/Elite/Piper, contact/tactile, rotation, formal-training-readiness or real-system claim.
runtime_estimate: Prior594 native forwards plus drift36.12s. This396-forward run adds multi-layer read-only capture, moments and small float64 decompositions; estimate1-4minutes as one logical CPU job including hashes. No training or feature extraction.
planning_skill_scope: Engineering diagnostic protocol and metric/limitation checklist; not a manuscript Results/Discussion section. No mock outcomes or manuscript templates.
